A rider's power curve from ZwiftPower

Source: R/cp.R
zp_power_curve.Rd

The best-power curve behind a ZwiftPower profile page (api3.php?do= critical_power_profile): best average watts for durations from 1 s to about an hour, over a rolling window, with the date and event of each best.

Usage

zp_power_curve(
  s,
  zwift_id,
  window = "90days",
  parse = "tbl",
  ttl = .zv_ttl("zp")
)

Arguments

s

A zp_session().

zwift_id

Zwift rider id.

window

"90days" (default), "30days", or an event id for that event's curve.

parse

"tbl", "json" or "resp".

ttl

Cache time-to-live in seconds.

Value

A tibble with one row per duration: secs, watts, date (POSIXct of the effort) and event_id. Zero rows when ZwiftPower holds no curve for the rider or window.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
zp <- zp_set_cookie(zp_session(), Sys.getenv("ZP_SID"))
zp_power_curve(zp, 1234567)
zp_power_curve(zp, 1234567, window = "30days")
} # }
